name: cyclin dependent kinase 6

function.text: CDK6 encodes cyclin-dependent kinase 6. Annotated molecular activities include protein serine kinase activity and cyclin-dependent protein serine/threonine kinase activity. It participates in signal transduction and gliogenesis.
